verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent) published by smolagents itself. The openapi.json found by the probe belongs to the Hugging Face Hub, the host platform, so it earns no credit here. Tool metadata for LLMs is a related feature, not a downloadable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
